definitions.explanation: A student enrolled in a faculty of medicine, training to become a doctor. The Japanese medical program is six years, so {医学生|いがくせい} typically spans first through sixth-year students.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{医学生|いがくせい}だ。
examples.english: My younger brother is a medical student.

examples.japanese: {医学生|いがくせい}は{試験|しけん}に{追|お}われる{毎日|まいにち}を{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: Medical students spend their days chased by exams.

examples.japanese: {六年生|ろくねんせい}の{医学生|いがくせい}は{病院|びょういん}で{実習|じっしゅう}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: Sixth-year medical students do their clinical training at hospitals.

notes:
{医学|いがく} (medicine) + {生|せい} (student). The {生|せい} suffix attaches to fields to form names for students of that field.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医学生|いがくせい}になる: to become a medical student
- {医学生|いがくせい}の{実習|じっしゅう}: medical-student clinical training
- {医学生|いがくせい}{時代|じだい}: one's days as a medical student

STUDENT SUFFIXES ({生|せい}):
- {大学生|だいがくせい}: university student
- {高校生|こうこうせい}: high-school student
- {留学生|りゅうがくせい}: international student
- {歯学生|しがくせい}: dental student

RELATED WORDS:
- {研修医|けんしゅうい}: medical resident (after graduation, in training)
- {医師|いし}: doctor, physician (licensed)
